v0.1.0_Initial_Release.description:
# __The EscAPists 2 v0.1.0 Initial Release!__

At long last, the release is here. I present to you all, The EscAPists 2. While this is by no means the final work, I am now at a point of being happy to release this to you all.

I've pushed this out a bit sooner than I had intended due to the announcement of 'The Escapists 3', but it should still be solid enough
You can find the full list of what's randomised within the GitHub repo's Readme, along with the setup instructions. There is stuff planned for future releases also in the readme

## Brief Overview of what's randomised:
Desks
Escapes
Stats
Jobs
Certain Blueprints required for escapes
Progressive Stats
Prison unlocks
Random Items

## Extra Features:
DeathLink - The DeathLink you all know and love!
StealthLink - If you trigger a lockdown in your prison, everyone else with the setting enabled gets one too!
Payphone Hints - Pay some money into a payphone and you'll get a random hint!

I hope you all have fun playing this, and if there's anything that you notice is broken, or you can think of suggestions, please let me know!

Client Repo: https://github.com/BigCelery842906/TheEscAPists2/
APWorld Repo: https://github.com/BigCelery842906/TE2Archipelago/

v0.1.1.description:
What's Changed:

Client:
Fixed an index issue with Rattlesnake Springs Desk Checks
The bridge now also outputs a log file for easier debugging
Game no longer spits out error messages while waiting on a bridge connection
The bridge will now show the text from the server instead of 3 statements for every check
Fixed Breathable Trash Bag Blueprint not working

APWorld:
Rattlesnake Springs Desk 36 is no longer a thing (Miscount goes crazy)
3 Desks in USS Anomaly have been updated to require a red key now (Namely 15, 19 and 23)
Super Whip Blueprint is now classed as progressive due to use in the Rock Hammer Hard Place Fort Tundra Escape
Lightweight Cutters are now put into the item pool
